title: Fund loss because of wrong amAmm Fee Amount
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When amAMM manager is enabled on the BunniHook, the code sets the wrong value for `amAmmFeeAmount` in `BunniHookLogic.beforeSwap()` function.  ```solidity            // decrease output amount             swapFeeAmount = outputAmount.mulDivUp(swapFee, SWAP_FEE_BASE);             (amAmmFeeCurrency, amAmmFeeAmount) = (outputToken, swapFeeAmount);              // take hook fees from swap fee             // @a: when there's amm whom does hook fee belongs? amFee should be only swapfee-hookfee             hookFeesAmount = swapFeeAmo
